title: Inspection Numbers Held in Facility-Contact Numbering (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
A facility-confirmed contact on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile also carries the **inspection number**: one number for each occupancy inspection visit whose result is recorded on the profile dated less than 6 whole calendar months before the handling date, up to two.

| Inspection results recorded within that period | Inspection number |
|---|---|
| two or more | 2 |
| exactly one | 1 |
| none | 0 |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

*Boundary (hypothetical dates).* A result dated 4 February counts on a handling date of 3 August of the same year (5 whole months) and no longer counts on 4 August (6 whole months).
